meta.title: MonsterTalk — Keep it chill. Take it seriously.
meta.description: Find native speakers, have real conversations, and level up your language skills together.

hero.subtitle: Find native speakers, have real conversations, and level up your language skills—together.

availability.title: Share your availability
availability.body: Set your time. You can host or join a conversation that fits your schedule.

groupChats.title: Join small group chats
groupChats.body: Up to 4 people in a video room. Real conversations, real connections.

reputation.title: Build your reputation
reputation.body: Show up, be respectful, and get positive feedback. Trust makes better talks.

together.title: Learn and teach together
together.body: Everyone gets a chance to speak, listen, and grow.

step2.title: Set your time
step2.body: Add the times you're available for practice.

step3.title: Find or join a room
step3.body: Pick a time, see who's in, and request to join.

step4.title: Talk, learn, and grow
step4.body: Have fun conversations, switch languages, and support each other.

sophie.name: Sophie
sophie.quote: I used to be so shy to speak English. Now I have regular partners and real conversations. This community is so warm!

lucas.name: Lucas
lucas.quote: Finally a place that's not weird and not too formal. I can learn Chinese and help others with Portuguese. Perfect!

minji.name: Minji
minji.quote: The small group chat is amazing. Everyone gets to speak and we actually become friends!
